definitions.explanation: A figure made of packed snow. Traditional Japanese snowmen are made of two stacked snowballs (not three as in Western style).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{雪|ゆき}だるまを{作|つく}った。
{庭|にわ}に{大|おお}きな{雪|ゆき}だるまが{立|た}っている。
examples.english: There's a big snowman standing in the garden.

examples.japanese: {暖|あたた}かくなって、{雪|ゆき}だるまが{溶|と}けてしまった。
examples.english: It got warm and the snowman melted away.

notes:
FORMATION:
{雪|ゆき} (snow) + だるま ({達磨|だるま}, Daruma doll). Named after the round shape of a Daruma doll.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese {雪|ゆき}だるま are made of two snowballs (head and body), unlike the Western three-ball snowman. The kanji form {雪達磨|ゆきだるま} exists but hiragana だるま is standard.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{雪|ゆき}だるまを{作|つく}る (to make a snowman)
・{雪|ゆき}だるまが{溶|と}ける (a snowman melts)
・{雪|ゆき}だるま{式|しき}に{増|ふ}える (to snowball, to increase rapidly — idiomatic)
